stories.title: 中国新发现一种有羽毛恐龙化石 为飞行特征差异演化提供新证据

en.title: China discovers new feathered dinosaur fossil providing new evidence for flight characteristic divergent evolution
en.summary: Researchers discovered a new feathered dinosaur species called Baishilong in northeastern China from 145 to 100 million years ago. The findings provide new evidence supporting theories about differences in flight-related trait evolution among various groups of bird-like dinosaurs.

stories.title: China returns to top 100 in gender parity ranking for first time since 2016

en.title: China returns to top 100 in gender parity ranking for first time since 2016
en.summary: China ranks 96th out of 145 economies in the 2026 Global Gender Gap Report, closing 69.9 percent of its gender gap. This marks the first time in a decade that China has entered the top 100 rankings, improving from 103rd place the previous year.

stories.title: No more welcome mat? Japan’s tough visa rules spur foreign businesses to look elsewhere

en.title: No more welcome mat? Japan's tough visa rules spur foreign businesses to look elsewhere
en.summary: New visa regulations in Japan have increased costs for foreign business operators and raised concerns among longtime foreign residents about their welcome. The stricter rules are prompting some foreign entrepreneurs to consider relocating their operations.

stories.title: Hong Kong to relax ad rules for broadcasters to boost business edge, minister says

en.title: Hong Kong to relax ad rules for broadcasters to boost business edge, minister says
en.summary: Hong Kong's commerce minister announced plans to relax advertising restrictions for broadcasters to help them compete with online and streaming platforms. The government is reviewing regulations in response to requests from broadcast operators seeking a more favorable business environment.

stories.title: 女子团体摘金 中国队首夺亚运会高尔夫项目金牌

en.title: Women's team wins gold; China secures first-ever Asian Games golf medal
en.summary: China won the gold medal in the women's team golf competition at the Nagoya Asian Games on October 3, marking the country's first gold medal in golf at the Asian Games.

en.title: Pet care services boom during holidays; trillion-yuan "pet economy" drives new consumer trends
en.summary: Pet boarding services experienced surging demand during China's October holiday period, with young entrepreneurs like a post-2000s pet care provider capitalizing on the rapidly growing pet economy sector.

en.summary: China's film industry is experiencing strong growth, with box office revenue surpassing 3 billion yuan in 2026 through innovative entertainment formats and strategies.

en.summary: The 18th Sihong International Grand Pond Fishing Competition took place with approximately 1,000 participants competing. A competitor from Zhoukou, Henan won the championship and million-yuan prize.

en.summary: During the National Day holiday, archaeological experience programs in Zhengzhou allowed visitors to engage with artifacts, observe restoration work, and participate in interactive activities exploring thousand-year-old civilization.

stories.title: More Chinese banks likely to adopt AI rules after Ping An move: analysts

en.title: More Chinese banks likely to adopt AI rules after Ping An move: analysts
en.summary: Ping An Bank became the first listed Chinese bank to formally adopt artificial intelligence governance rules, with analysts predicting other mainland financial institutions will follow suit as regulators push for stronger AI oversight in the sector.

stories.title: McDonald’s sells Hong Kong shop for US$15.3 million as ‘old money’ returns to retail

en.title: McDonald's sells Hong Kong shop for US$15.3 million as 'old money' returns to retail
en.summary: McDonald's has sold a Hong Kong property housing its first New Territories restaurant for HK$120 million to Keen Charm Holdings, continuing its year-long divestment of self-owned locations as traditional wealth re-enters the retail property market.

stories.title: Clara Chan retains helm at HKIC as HK$62b state fund aligns with city’s 5-year plan

en.title: Clara Chan retains helm at HKIC as HK$62b state fund aligns with city's 5-year plan
en.summary: Hong Kong Investment Corporation's CEO Clara Chan has been reappointed for three additional years through October 2029, as the government-backed fund managing HK$62 billion supports emerging industries aligned with the city's five-year development strategy.

stories.title: Developers vie to land plum HK$2 billion residential site in Ho Man Tin

en.title: Developers vie to land plum HK$2 billion residential site in Ho Man Tin
en.summary: Ten developers submitted bids for Hong Kong's sole residential site in the latest government land sale programme before Friday's deadline. Major firms including Chinachem Group, Wheelock Properties, Kerry Properties and Sun Hung Kai Properties competed for the Fat Kwong Street site in Ho Man Tin.

stories.title: Hong Kong IPOs falter, China aids homebuyers, EU trade talks

en.title: Hong Kong IPOs falter, China aids homebuyers, EU trade talks
en.summary: Hong Kong's initial public offerings are struggling as investor appetite weakens relative to supply. Seven of twelve September debuts fell on their first trading day, with fifteen flops recorded in the third quarter compared to fourteen declines in the first half of the year.
